summary: Priya reviewed her November finances after salary credit. Food delivery spend was Rs.12,240 last month — higher than expected. She committed to cutting it in half and transferring Rs.30,000 to her house fund by the 25th. Upcoming bills of Rs.46,500 were reviewed and the savings plan was confirmed as realistic with a Rs.51,500 buffer remaining.
